verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI is documented as an AI assistant feature and the product ships an official MCP server, both of which point toward natural-language interaction with monitoring data, but the evidence pack gives only title-level doc links with no detail on the scope of natural-language commands or independent corroboration of how it works in practice. missing for 10: detailed docs/examples of Bits AI command syntax or scope, independent/hands-on validation that natural-language commands actually drive actions, clarity on MCP server enabling NL-to-tool-call workflows.
